note: Hashables redesign pitch, revision 4 - a clean coconut palm silhouette for the home hero (fal flux-pro ultra), replacing the cut-out of the client's posterised pink-palms art. Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/palm-plan.json --key-file <path>. The chosen render (P-PALMS-B) is keyed and coloured by tools/palms.py. Illustrative only. The other three were candidates: optional, so a plain re-run never pays for them again.
